messages:
nina: FYI new hire hitting onboarding friction on Apple Silicon. `bundle install` in the ruby quickstart fails during native extension compile (nokogiri/libxml). Can someone triage?

ravi: Seen this a lot. On M1 it's usually missing Xcode CLT or libxml2 headers, or the lockfile doesn't include darwin platform binaries. What error do they see?

nina: `clang: error: no such file or directory` then nokogiri build fails. They are using rbenv with ruby 3.0.2.

jon: Quick wins: 1) `xcode-select --install`, 2) `brew install libxml2 libxslt`, 3) `bundle config build.nokogiri --use-system-libraries --with-xml2-include=$(brew --prefix libxml2)/include/libxml2`. Also `gem install nokogiri -- --use-system-libraries` can dodge bundler pain.

ravi: Another pattern: add `BUNDLED WITH` block or `bundle lock --add-platform x86_64-darwin-20` so CI uses precompiled gems when available. For quickstarts we should avoid asking new hires to run those flags manually.

nina: Agreed. Proposal: add a small `bin/setup` script that runs the checks and prints actionable hints (CLT, brew, or falls back to Docker). That keeps README small but provides one-click setup.

jon: I like `bin/setup`. Also add a `make dev` target that starts a Docker container with pinned Ruby + bundler so people can opt out of host setup.

ravi: And a CI smoke job in .github/workflows/quickstart-install.yml that runs `bundle install` on macos-latest and ubuntu-latest matrix to catch regressions. Keeps patch small but effective.

nina: I'll open a tiny PR: README blurb + `bin/setup` + CI smoke. Linking PR when ready.

devex-bot: [automation] PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/219 (devex/setup-script-and-macos-smoke) by nina

nina: Thanks all. Follow-up: should quickstart prefer Docker by default? My thought: keep host-first but make Docker super obvious with a single `make dev` command. That keeps contributors happy and avoids surprise native gem failures in first-day onboarding.

jon: Agreed. Docker first for reproducibility is tempting, but host instructions are still important for those who don’t run Docker. Document both with clear callouts.

ravi: Cool. I'll review the PR and add the CI job example. :thumbsup:
